baseline_fields_permitted_after_original: Original authenticated market OHLC/status/limits/calendar and projected execution quotes
Market-only causal features: support_floor, ATR/MA/returns/known flags computed from unchanged original input clock
baseline_state_not_permitted_after_branc: Later baseline fills/new BUY/quantity or completion/pause used to seed a branch
local_owned_state: Each ON/OFF simulation must own actual original entryfill cost, fixed Q, original entry index/deadline/reservation, D-open fill processing, held, entry-dayGRACE and inherited pending until its first actual sale. Recompute netP/costloss and exit selection each D from this state plus market-only data. No resetting original entry age/deadline at SHOCK D.
control_start: Original actual BUY E is authenticated as seed. At E open inject only this original filled BUY/Q/price/fee, then evaluate E close if it is an original source decision day. Original prospective BUY price contract is authenticated from its order and public resolver; no alternative BUY is generated.
control_end: Stop at the first actual SELL execution event at E open. Compare ON all source D decisions, targets, exit predicates and SELL intents from entry through the last still-held D and each blocked/pending D, then compare the final SELL E order linkage/fill availability/trigger/price/Q/fee and zero held quantity. The original full account's later close on that same E date may already plan a new BUY or consume a pause slot. That after-sale flat decision belongs to a later opportunity and is outside this one-cycle target equivalence contract; record it only as provenance, never simulate it or demand its target as a local control value.
cash_common_terminal: Original ON after-fee proceeds stay cash without interest/re-entry until both branches have liquidated. On the actual population the later branch normally defines the common point; no annual or later policy path enters the label.
cutoff_clock: Use original absolute calculation/entry indices and valid D-to-E pairs, not a freshly zero-based local age to set deadlines. Source decisions end2026-10-14; only pre-existing pending instructions may execute2026-10-15. If not liquidated then preserve CENSORED and null label, do not invent D10/15 decisions.
